body: Founder: 'we want to make the jungle more dynamic and alive those concepts come from the original game' -> 'the jungle right now is like nothing we need more going on' -> 'use it as inspiration in terms of mob types and write it into a northstar.' Resolves §20.4's own deferred question: builds a separate true jungle-camp system alongside node-guardian creeps, not a rework. Reviewed REDGARDEN/wiki/SPEC-4 (a Card-RTS spec for a different unbuilt game mode, type collisions with local_game.h checked and confirmed) and extracted what actually transfers: tiered mob archetypes + weighted target scoring. Grounded the GFD-graft direction §8 already committed to in GFD's real mob.go/nm.go state-machine + placeholder/window/respawn boss pattern. Spec only, no code, real open questions flagged (tone, roster size, placement).
title: docs: NORTHSTAR §22, real jungle camps spec (mob roster + GFD-pattern lifecycle)
